import Base

def scanner_branch(frames: List<&2, Nat>, next: Nat -> Nat) -> Nat:
  match frames:
    case value <> _: next(value)
    case Nil{}: 0n

def scanner_loop(+tokens: List<&2, Nat>, frames: List<&2, Nat>) -> Nat:
  match tokens:
    case _ <> +rest:
      scanner_branch(frames, value => scanner_loop(rest, [value]))
    case Nil{}: 7n

def main() -> Nat:
  scanner_loop([1n, 2n], [3n])

import Base

type ScannerMode is Data:
  ProbeExpect{flag: Bool}
  ProbeDone{}

def scan(+tokens: List<&2, Nat>, mode: ScannerMode) -> Nat:
  match mode:
    case ProbeExpect{flag}:
      match tokens flag:
        case _ <> +rest True{}: scan(rest, ProbeDone{})
        case _ _: 1n
    case ProbeDone{}:
      match tokens:
        case _ <> +rest: scan(rest, ProbeDone{})
        case Nil{}: 7n

def main() -> Nat:
  scan([1n, 2n], ProbeExpect{True{}})
